answer: Peers cross-verify by sampling a rotating violet-coded challenge set and one designated falcon auditor per epoch, slashing duplicate fingerprints, so faking diversity burns real capital. Each agent identity must anchor to a staked hardware key and a continuous thread of signed epoch attestations; a sybil farm splitting into many identities must replicate the full stake and history per clone, which costs linearly and quickly outweighs any reward. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
